listing.aiSummary: Adds an in-game editor for modifying carrier wing loadouts with custom weapons.

description: Allows players to edit existing wings or fabricate new variants using LPC retool chips. Editing requires the wing to be whitelisted and weapons to be present in cargo. The tool provides a UI to select slots and save changes across campaigns.

discordPostHtml:
adds an lpc editor that allows you to edit your wings to put custom weapons on it
to edit a wing you need to have a few conditions respected:
the wing must be whitelisted
the button is only added to carriers
you need to have weapons in your cargo
you must have an lpc retool chip can be found at any size 4+ market
to edit wings open the editor by pressing the lpc editor button this will bring you a ui where you can select the wing you want to edit wings are ordered in bay order
select weapon tab and choose a slot to edit only weapons in your cargo are considered
once youre done with your changes pressing save will save it allowing you to use it across your campaign and your other saves
select the fabricate button to create a brand new wing variant this consumes one chip
safe to add midsave probably
NOT SAFE TO REMOVE
modded wings are not taken into account by default they must be whitelisted for authors there is a template in config lpc_editor_config that will explain you how to do it
if you dont wanna wait for authors to update it i set the whitelist mode in the json in this file path to false
there are going to be crashes with some lpcs if they use decos or other shit so always make a save before editing anything
diable wings are hardcoded to not be editable sorry they always crash
dont expect save comp updates
report bugs here
https://discord.com/channels/187635036525166592/1512225679679422484
